Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), game text: “USED: At a system or Bespin location, choose: Cancel a just drawn destiny targeting the ability or defense value of your non-Undercover character of ability < 5. OR During battle, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. LOST: Cancel Close Call.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_032021.pdf Errata Sheet 2021 Spring] (Players Committee), page 2, PDF built 14 March 2021. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF; its transparent areas (where the card underneath shows through) are shown white.

Edits: none.
